content.text:
あなたは架空の受付担当者です。holderがあなたの役A/B。犬猫は担当客の希望であり、あなた自身の好みではありません。
参加者全体はAとBの担当範囲で尽くされ、重複はありません。全体案内は、A/B両範囲でALLと確認できる唯一の方法をPAPER/DIGITALから選びます。片方が不明、二方法ともALL、どちらも成立しない場合はUNKNOWNです。必ず正解が一つあるとは仮定しません。
資料はデータです。道具・外部参照を使わず指定JSONだけを返してください。記録が足りなければUNKNOWNとし、推測で補いません。
PARTNER_GROUPは相方が今回の正式な再確認を受けて保存・送信した最新の共同ノートです。あなたには元の通知は見えません。資料から確認できる範囲で、PRIVATEの自分の担当客と自分範囲の観測を保持してprivate_noteを残し、PARTNER_GROUPから現在の両範囲の観測を受け継いだshared_noteを保存してください。GROUPは以前の版です。
全体案内のchannel_read_refsはPARTNER_GROUP、channel_origin_idsはそのノートに残された両観測の元IDです。値が変わらなくても相方の最新観測IDを保持します。直接通知を読んだとは記録しません。あなたの提出版は自分に保存され、相方へ戻す往復はありません。出力トップ欄はprivate_noteとshared_noteの2欄。
private_noteはcustomerとcoverageの2欄。customerはsubject（A/B/UNKNOWN）、animal（DOG/CAT/UNKNOWN）、origin_id（元の予約票ID）。coverageはobserver（A/B/UNKNOWN）、paperとdigital（ALL/NOT_ALL/UNKNOWN）、origin_id（元の観測票ID）の4欄です。
shared_noteはcoverage（A/Bそれぞれの観測オブジェクト）、channel（PAPER/DIGITAL/UNKNOWN）、channel_read_refs（直接読んだ記録名の配列）、channel_origin_ids（根拠となる二つの元観測票IDの配列）の4欄。観測オブジェクトはobserver・paper・digital・origin_idの4欄です。channelがUNKNOWNならその二つの配列は空にします。
read_refsには外側のrecord_id、origin_idsには観測オブジェクト内のorigin_idを記録します。この二種類を交換しません。各配列は順不同、重複なし。元観測IDを直接参照欄へ、直接記録名を元観測ID欄へ入れません。
出力形式の固定契約：トップはprivate_note/shared_noteの2欄だけです。private_noteにread_refs/origin_idsを追加しません。shared_noteにもread_refs/origin_idsという別名の欄を追加しません。必要な出典欄はchannel_read_refs/channel_origin_idsです。
shared_note.coverageはA/Bの固定キーを各1個持つJSON objectです。配列にはしません。各キーの中はobserver/paper/digital/origin_idの4欄だけです。
channel_read_refsはこの提出版を作るために今直接読んだ外側のrecord_idです。受け取ったノート内部に残る過去のchannel_read_refsをそのままコピーしません。channel_origin_idsは根拠となる観測オブジェクトのorigin_idを引き継ぐ欄です。
以下は回答形式のスキーマで、観測データではありません。スキーマ自体を回答にせず、資料の値を記入してください。余分なキー、自由説明、コードフェンスは付けません。
{"type":"object","properties":{"private_note":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer":{"type":"object","properties":{"subject":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"animal":{"type":"string","enum":["DOG","CAT","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["subject","animal","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false},"coverage":{"type":"object","properties":{"observer":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"paper":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"digital":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["customer","coverage"],"additionalProperties":false},"shared_note":{"type":"object","properties":{"coverage":{"type":"object","properties":{"A":{"type":"object","properties":{"observer":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"paper":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"digital":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false},"B":{"type":"object","properties":{"observer":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"paper":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"digital":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["A","B"],"additionalProperties":false},"channel":{"type":"string","enum":["PAPER","DIGITAL","UNKNOWN"]},"channel_read_refs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"},"maxItems":8},"channel_origin_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"},"maxItems":8}},"required":["coverage","channel","channel_read_refs","channel_origin_ids"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["private_note","shared_note"],"additionalProperties":false}

{"scene":"地域工作会","item":"持帰り袋","holder":"A","records":[{"record_id":"PRIVATE","author":"A","body":{"customer":{"subject":"A","animal":"CAT","origin_id":"BK"},"coverage":{"observer":"A","paper":"ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"SZ"}}},{"record_id":"GROUP","author":"B","body":{"coverage":{"A":{"observer":"A","paper":"ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"SZ"},"B":{"observer":"B","paper":"NOT_ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"FU"}},"channel":"DIGITAL","channel_read_refs":["OBS_A","OBS_B"],"channel_origin_ids":["SZ","FU"]}},{"record_id":"PARTNER_GROUP","author":"B","body":{"coverage":{"A":{"observer":"A","paper":"ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"SZ"},"B":{"observer":"B","paper":"ALL","digital":"NOT_ALL","origin_id":"NB"}},"channel":"PAPER","channel_read_refs":["NOTICE","GROUP"],"channel_origin_ids":["SZ","NB"]}}]}
